# Copilot: Working in this website repo
- Static personal site (no bundler); `index.html` is the root entry, with legacy mini-sites under folders like `DragonEye/` and `etc/PCB/`. Edit assets in-place under `styles/`, `js/`, `images/`, `assets/`.
- Test service-worker changes via an HTTP server from the repo root (e.g. `python -m http.server 8000`); opening `index.html` directly bypasses SW registration and cache updates.
- Respect the script order in `index.html`: jQuery/jQuery UI/GSAP load synchronously, feature scripts use `defer`, then `js/loading_text.js` and `js/app.js` load last. Keep `window.toggleFunction`, `remove_loader_screen`, and `write_code` globals intact for backward compatibility.
- `js/app.js` instantiates `WebsiteUtils` and orchestrates loader UX, nav/mobile menu, smooth scroll, parallax via `--parallax-transform`, code demo triggers, EmailJS setup, and SW registration. Toggle the `DEBUG_MODE` flag to `false` before production deploys.
- Interactive modules: `js/coditor.js` + `js/nn.js` animate the code/NN demo when `write_code(0)` fires; `js/wind.js`, `js/leaves.js`, and `js/flowers.js` draw decorative SVG motion; `js/contact_animation.js` binds the SVGator robot to scroll progress (requires the `data-contact-animation-*` hooks).
- `js/loading_text.js` exposes `display_random_loading_text(id)`; `app.js` calls it during the loader. Update message pools there if you need new copy.
- Loader debugging: append `?skipLoading` to the URL to bypass the splash; `WebsiteUtils` also reveals the skip button after ~5s—keep that behavior aligned with the loader copy and accessibility messaging.
- Email form (`.email-form`) relies on `js/email_box.js`: validates via `validateMessage`, animates the button with GSAP, and posts through EmailJS using the hardcoded public key `iSCxOn0RbDVs4wgML`, service `service_h4uzc6r`, and template `template_qsr6ce3`. Preserve those IDs or coordinate replacements with the owner.
- Motion & audio: `setupAboutPhotoBurst` (in `app.js`) plays `images/my-photo-beat.mp3` once the user interacts. It and other effects short-circuit when `prefers-reduced-motion` is true—follow the same guard for new animations.
- Key IDs/structures to keep (linked across JS): element id `coditor_nn_block`, editor code block id `editor`, neural net SVG id `neuralnet`, wind SVG id `gardenwind`, the nav toggle pairing `aria-controls="navDemo"` with element id `navDemo`, form class `.email-form`, and the attribute `[data-contact-animation-shell]`. Changing any of them requires mirroring updates across the linked JS.
- Styling lives mainly in `styles/main.css` with hero backgrounds keyed by `hero-section--*` classes and motion helpers like `.section-with-flowers`. Add new hero variants there and maintain accessible color contrast.
- Service worker (`sw.js`) caches absolute paths and is registered as `/sw.js`. If deploying under a sub-path, change registration to `sw.js`, convert `CACHE_URLS` to relative strings, and bump `CACHE_NAME` whenever the asset list changes.
- When adding assets that load during the splash screen or critical interactions, update `CACHE_URLS` to keep offline parity and remember to increment `CACHE_NAME`.
- Avoid duplicating inline handlers: if you remove an `onclick` in HTML, wire the equivalent listener inside `WebsiteUtils` to prevent double binding with the legacy markup.
- Accessibility: skip link uses `.sr-only` helpers; interactive decorative content sets `aria-hidden` where appropriate. Preserve ARIA labels and keyboard bindings (e.g. Enter/Space triggers in the creativity word and photo stack).
- Sub-pages reuse the same asset folders. Keep relative URLs stable—many image references point upward (`../images/...`).
- Before modifying Snap.svg animations, confirm `Snap` is still loaded via the deferred `js/snap.svg-min.js`; new SVG interactions should piggyback on the existing instances instead of spawning additional roots.
- Large JS files enable module exports for testing; keep them CommonJS-compatible if you refactor.
- If you add analytics or other background sync work, ensure the SW’s `fetch` handler skips non-GET requests and external origins, and gate new sync tags within the existing listeners.
- Ask the site owner whether EmailJS credentials, deployment base path, or preferred local dev command need to be updated—the current values are hardcoded.
